_doc: #195 (w180, 2026-11-15, RULES-slices195): roles of the 15 slices' calib c parts, for ledger_add.py (ROLES argument). As ledger-roles-190cd.json / -190ef.json: the ledger's vocabulary has no 'search' or 'confirm' role, so every part is 'select'; the slice's role is in the note and in the registry. The x parts (xcorp pieces: xc8k-b1 / b2 Latin, the fresh non-Latin batch xn8k-b195) read no calib and have no ledger rows. Not merged into eval/pools/ledger-roles.json (lead's call).

golden-s195s1-c.note: #195 (w180, 11-15, RULES-slices195 §2): calib c part of search slice s195s1 (one of 5 cycling search slices; pairs with confirm s195c1 and s195c6): Latin documents of the merged fit + search pool, the more used third of the allowed pool (retired search / V2-era documents, least used first by V3 decision count), cut at 4,096 tokens; disjoint from the other 14 slices. The x part (retired xcorp Latin pieces + fresh non-Latin pieces of xn8k-b195) reads no calib. Staged, not ready.
